name: INV-CE-XX
subtitle: Industrial 5G/4G Edge Computer
description: A rugged, fanless SD-WAN edge appliance powered by Intel X7425E, designed for high-performance networking at distributed sites. It combines multi-WAN connectivity (Ethernet, 4G/5G, Wi-Fi) with flexible OS support and industrial-grade reliability, making it ideal for seamless failover, traffic optimisation, and edge computing. Best suited for telecom, industrial IoT, smart infrastructure, and enterprise branch deployments.

Up to 512 GB SSD and up to 64 GB eMMC (optional across all devices except arrowlake)

use_cases.title: Enterprise Branch Connectivity
use_cases.desc: Provides secure and uninterrupted connectivity for branch offices with multi-WAN support (SD-WAN), enabling seamless failover and optimized network performance.

use_cases.title: Infotainment System for Vehicles
use_cases.desc: The Intel X7425E platform enables advanced vehicle infotainment, telematics, and connectivity solutions. It supports GPS navigation, multimedia applications, 4G/5G communication, Wi-Fi hotspot functionality, and real-time vehicle monitoring, making it ideal for connected vehicles, fleet management, and smart transportation systems.
